title: Web-only error-code literal
description: Numeric literals compared with Get(LastError) whose code Claris marks (*) - returned only by the web publishing engine or a FileMaker REST API (Data API, OData, Admin API; fm_spec error_codes scope 'web', fm-spec 2.8.0+). Inventory, not defects: the comparison is right in a web context and unreachable in a FileMaker Pro/Go client script - the finding names the code so the context can be judged.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Web-only codes never occur in a client-side script; a script comparing against them either runs in a web context (fine) or carries a branch that cannot fire.
rule.remediation: Nothing to fix by itself. Confirm the script runs under WebDirect, the Data API or Custom Web Publishing; in a pure client script the branch is dead.

defaultResult.name: finding_count
defaultResult.meaning: Comparisons of Get(LastError) with a code returned only by the web publishing engine or a REST API

params.name: file
params.description: Optional file filter (from the app-level filter).
